title.en: Common English usage errors to fix

items.wrong: One of my friends are preparing for the examination.
items.right: One of my friends is preparing for the examination.

rule.en: The subject "one" is singular, so the verb is "is".
rule.hi: विषय 'one' एकवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया 'is' होगी।

items.wrong: He is senior than me in service.
items.right: He is senior to me in service.

rule.hi: Senior, junior, superior, inferior के साथ 'to' आता है, 'than' नहीं।

items.wrong: Each of the students have submitted the form.
items.right: Each of the students has submitted the form.

rule.hi: 'Each' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है, जैसे 'has'।

rule.en: Verbs of knowing and believing are not usually used in the continuous form.
rule.hi: जानने और मानने वाली क्रियाएँ सामान्यतः continuous रूप में नहीं आतीं।

items.wrong: Despite of the rain, the meeting was held.
items.right: Despite the rain, the meeting was held.

rule.en: 'Despite' is not followed by 'of'; 'in spite of' is.
rule.hi: 'Despite' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता; 'in spite of' आता है।

items.wrong: We discussed about the new policy.

rule.hi: 'Discuss' के बाद सीधे कर्म आता है, 'about' नहीं।
